historical_notes: Firms are concentrated in Basle, Lausanne, Zurich and Winterthur, the main Swiss commercial and industrial centres.
Sulzer Frères of Winterthur, a major engineering firm, is listed for both centrifugal pumps and rail motor cars.
Schindler of Lucerne, listed for pulley blocks, is known today mainly for lifts and escalators.
Berna of Olten was a Swiss commercial vehicle maker, listed here for post vans.

The Canadian Pacific Railway and Dominion Express Company appear through their London office and their Basle general agents, Goth & Co. This points to transatlantic travel and freight links, and the directory's English-language, British-oriented audience.
